steps.do: Find every personal checking account that passes all four checks. (1) Tenure: the referrer's tenure meets the account's minimum (Light Green 14 days; Blue, Green, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Gold Years 30; Dark Green, Evergreen, Purple 45; Bluest 60).
